name: 陳怡倩
objective:
This course centers on international current affairs and aims to develop students’ ability to comprehend, respond to, analyze, and articulate ideas in spoken English interaction. Through class discussion, small-group dialogue, issue-based responses, position statements, and short oral presentations, students will learn to approach international events from multiple perspectives, organize information, identify viewpoints, and participate in discussion in clear and logical English. The course also emphasizes the development of critical thinking and global awareness in order to strengthen students’ English communication skills in the context of global issues.
本課程以國際時事為主軸，培養學生於英語口語互動中之理解、回應、分析與論述能力。藉由課堂討論、小組對話、議題回應、立場表述及簡短口頭報告等活動，學生將學習從多元角度理解國際事件，整理資訊、辨識觀點，並以清楚且具邏輯的英語參與討論。課程亦著重培養批判思考與國際視野，以提升學生在全球議題脈絡中之英語溝通能力。
schedule:
Week 1 Course Introduction
Week 2 Foundations of Media Literacy I 
Week 3 Foundations of Media Literacy II
Week 4 Geopolitics & Borders: Understanding major international conflicts
Week 5 Climate & Environment: Discussing global climate policies and disasters.
Week 6 Science, Tech, & Society: AI, space exploration, and social media regulation.
Week 7 Global Economics: Inflation, trade wars, and how they affect daily life.
Week 8 Human Rights & Social Movements: Analyzing global protests and activism.
Week 9 Mid-term evaluation
Week 10 Pop Culture & Soft Power I: The global impact of movies, music (K-Pop, Hollywood), and sports (The Olympics/World Cup).
Week 11 Pop Culture & Soft Power II: The global impact of movies, music (K-Pop, Hollywood), and sports (The Olympics/World Cup).
Week 12 Week 10 Pop Culture & Soft Power III: The global impact of movies, music (K-Pop, Hollywood), and sports (The Olympics/World Cup).
Week 13 The Role of Photojournalism: How images tell a story when words fail.
Week 14 Public Health & Pandemics: How international bodies (like the WHO) and media handle global health scares.
Week 15 Resource Wars: The geopolitics of water scarcity, rare earth minerals, and energy dependency.
Week 16 The Future of War & Peace: Cybersecurity, drone warfare, and the role of international law in modern conflict.
Week 17 Final Evaluation
Week 18 Final Project Due; Final Project Presentations
scorePolicy: Active class participation & class activities (45%); weekly news log (10%); mid-term evaluation (15%); final evaluation(15%); final project (15%)
